era: 1820 年 5 月 12 日生于意大利佛罗伦萨（父母游欧途中，以城市命名），出身英国富裕乡绅家庭，自幼受父亲亲授数学、统计、古典语言与哲学——1837 年记下'上帝召我侍奉'的志向日记，此后与'婚姻-庄园'的既定人生轨道长期对抗——1851 年赴德国凯撒斯韦特女执事护理机构见习三个月，成为极少受过系统训练的护士——1853 年出任伦敦上哈利街'患病贵妇疗养院'监督，首次展示医院管理才能——1854 年 10 月克里米亚战争爆发后，应战争大臣西德尼·赫伯特之邀率 38 名护士赴斯库塔里军医院：面对死亡率高达 42%-60% 的惨状，她先建病案与死亡登记制度，再推动通风、洗涤、供水与营养改革——1855 年 3 月英国政府卫生委员会抵埠大扫除后死亡率骤降，她据此确知：杀死士兵的主要不是战伤而是可预防疾病——1856 年归国后拒绝'提灯女神'的英雄叙事，转而以'激情统计学家'身份打一场数据战：与总登记处统计学家威廉·法尔合作两年，重算克里米亚死亡数据，1858 年印行机密报告《关于影响英国陆军健康、效率与医院管理之事项》，1859 年匿名出版《英国陆军卫生史略》反驳'夸大死亡数'的指控并证明自己反而低估——发明极区面积图（'鸡冠花图'/'玫瑰图'），并在发现半径长度误导视觉后改为面积与死亡率成比例（平方根标度），使'可预防疾病死亡的蓝色楔面压倒战伤红色楔面'一图定案——推动 1857 年陆军卫生皇家委员会成立，把陆军年均死亡率从改革前的角度钉进制度：此后英国本土营房、印度驻军卫生调查（1863《印度驻军英国士兵死亡率观察》）、医院统计国际标准化（1860 年国际统计大会方案、1863《医院笔记》论'不问年龄性别与术后并发症的粗死亡率毫无实际用途'）、圣托马斯医院护士学校（1860，现代护理教育起点）与《护理笔记》（1859，'护理即把人体置于最佳复愈环境'的环境论）——她终生未入公立纪念体系，晚年缠绵病榻仍以每日千计的书信远程指挥全球卫生改革，1910 年 8 月 13 日于伦敦逝世，享年 90 岁。
era_en: Born 12 May 1820 in Florence (named after her birthplace) to a wealthy English family; tutored by her father in mathematics, statistics, classical languages and philosophy—wrote of a divine call to service at 17 and defied the expected path of marriage and estate management—trained for three months at Kaiserswerth (1851) and became superintendent of the Institute for the Care of Sick Gentlewomen in London (1853)—in October 1854, at Sidney Herbert's request, led 38 nurses to the Barrack Hospital at Scutari, where she instituted patient records and mortality registration and drove ventilation, laundry, water and diet reform; after the government Sanitary Commission's flushing of the sewers in March 1855 mortality collapsed, and she drew the statistical conclusion that preventable disease, not wounds, was killing the army—returning in 1856 she rejected the 'Lady with the Lamp' hero narrative and fought instead as a 'passionate statistician': for two years with William Farr of the General Register Office she recomputed the Crimean data, privately printed Notes on Matters Affecting the Health of the British Army (1858), and anonymously published A Contribution to the Sanitary History of the British Army (1859) to prove her critics wrong and herself an under-estimator—inventing the polar-area ('coxcomb'/'rose') diagram and, after realising radial length misleads the eye, re-scaling so that areas were proportional to death rates (square-root scale), fixing forever the image of blue preventable-disease wedges dwarfing red wound wedges—forced the Royal Commission on the Health of the Army (1857), then extended the same statistical method to British barracks, to the mortality of the British army in India (1863), to international standardisation of hospital statistics (1860 International Statistical Congress scheme; Notes on Hospitals 1863: crude death rates 'without reference to age, sex, operation or complications can convey no practical result'), to the Nightingale Training School at St Thomas's (1860), and to Notes on Nursing (1859), which defined nursing as putting the body in the best condition for repair—bedridden for decades yet directing global sanitary reform through thousands of letters a year, she died in London on 13 August 1910, aged 90.
school: 经验主义卫生改革 / 维多利亚统计运动 / 医院管理与护理学奠基
historical_significance: 现代护理学与医院统计学双料奠基人：以死亡登记与卫生干预的先后对照完成了医学史上最早的'干预-死亡率'因果论证之一；以极区面积图把统计证据转译为决策者一眼可懂的视觉论证，开创数据可视化说服的传统；以 1860 年国际统计大会方案首次推动医院统计的跨院可比化（年龄、性别、病类、术后并发症分层）；以圣托马斯护士学校把护理从仆役杂务改造为有训练、有记录、有伦理的职业；以《护理笔记》确立环境-复愈理论，比现代流行病学早半个世纪锁定'可预防疾病'作为主要死因并可干预的信念。
historical_significance_en: Dual founder of modern nursing and hospital statistics: her sequencing of mortality registration and sanitary intervention constitutes one of medicine's earliest intervention-versus-mortality causal arguments; her polar-area diagram pioneered the tradition of translating statistical evidence into one-glance visual arguments for decision-makers; her 1860 International Statistical Congress scheme first drove cross-hospital comparability of medical statistics (stratified by age, sex, disease class and post-operative complications); her Nightingale Training School turned nursing from domestic drudgery into a trained, recorded, ethical profession; and Notes on Nursing established the environment-repair theory, locking in—half a century before modern epidemiology—the belief that preventable disease was the dominant, and governable, cause of death.
unique_thinking: 南丁格尔的思维内核是'把道德义愤翻译成统计证据，再把统计证据翻译成权力能执行的图形'：她不满足于'士兵死得太多'的叙事，而坚持追问'死于什么、死于哪月、死于何种条件'——用底册化的死亡登记把'惨状'拆成可分层的读数；用'卫生委员会干预前后'的月度死亡率对照完成准实验归因，自己先于任何人承认护理本身非主因（'真正的功劳属于管道工与下水道'）；在图形表达上她自我纠错——发现半径长度与面积的视觉错觉后主动废弃自己的初版图式，改用平方根标度使面积正比于死亡率；在制度层面她把'一次战役的教训'固化为常设皇家委员会、标准化统计格式与职业训练体系，使改革不依赖任何一个人的在场。
unique_thinking_en: Nightingale's cognitive core is translating moral outrage into statistical evidence, and statistical evidence into graphics that power can execute: she refused the narrative of 'too many soldiers died' and insisted on asking what they died of, in which month, under which conditions—turning 'appalling scenes' into stratified readings through ledger-style death registration; she ran a quasi-experimental attribution via month-by-month mortality before and after the Sanitary Commission's intervention, and was the first to insist that nursing itself was not the main cause ('the true heroes are the plumbers'); in graphics she self-corrected—abandoning her own first diagram once she saw the area/length illusion, re-scaling to square roots so areas matched death rates; institutionally she converted a single campaign's lesson into a standing Royal Commission, standardised statistical formats and a professional training system, so reform no longer depended on any single person's presence.
civilization_zh: 维多利亚时代的英国：免费诊所与总登记处共生的早期国家统计体系、克里米亚战争暴露的陆军行政危机、贵格与福音派慈善传统、女性被排除于职业与学会之外而以'私人影响力'运作的时代
civilization_en: Victorian Britain: an early national statistical apparatus (General Register Office), the administrative crisis exposed by the Crimean War, Quaker and Evangelical philanthropy, and an era in which women were barred from professions and learned societies and had to operate through private influence
roles_zh: 护士与护理教育家；统计学家与数据可视化先驱；卫生改革与军队行政改革推手；医院设计者；印度公共卫生调查主持人
roles_en: Nurse and nursing educator; statistician and data-visualisation pioneer; sanitary and army-administrative reformer; hospital designer; director of Indian public-health inquiry

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/统计登记驱动的实证改革
modes.definition_zh: 改革实证方法论/先建底册再谈主张：面对无法量化的'惨状'叙事，第一动作不是控诉而是建立逐案登记——每个死亡记录病因、时点、所在病房与条件，使总体'惨状'变成可分层、可对比、可追责的读数；没有底册的义愤只是情绪，有底册的义愤才是证据
modes.definition_en: Reform methodology: before any claim, build the register — every death recorded by cause, date, ward and conditions, so that an unquantifiable narrative of 'appalling scenes' becomes stratified, comparable, accountable readings; indignation without a ledger is emotion, indignation with a ledger is evidence
modes.source_chapter: 《关于影响英国陆军健康、效率与医院管理之事项》(1858)、《英国陆军卫生史略》(1859)
key_concepts: 登记底册 the register（逐案死亡登记——证据的原子单位）
分层读数 stratified readings（按病因/时点/病房切片）
可追责性 accountability（每条记录对应可核查的事实）
modes.key_quote_zh: 统计的主要目的不应是告诉政府死了多少人，而是使防止疾病与死亡蔓延的直接步骤能够立即被采取——而要防止，先要知道死于什么、何地、何时。
modes.key_quote_en: The main end of statistics should not be to inform the Government as to how many men have died, but to enable immediate steps to be taken to prevent the extension of disease and mortality — and to prevent, one must first know of what, where, and when.
process_zh: 把叙事问题翻译为登记问题：'士兵死得太多'先改写为'每个死者死于什么、死在哪张床上'——不登记就没有可讨论的对象
设计底册字段：病因（战伤/时疫/其他）、时点（逐月）、地点（病房/营地），字段先于采集定死，防止事后挑数据
建立采集流程：护士交班记录与医院文书对接，逐日入册——底册的生命力在持续不在完整
以底册回敬质疑：当'夸大死亡数'的指控出现时，不辩论情绪，直接用陆军部自己的登记数字复算——1859 年《英国陆军卫生史略》证明指控者错、自己反而低估
process_en: Translate the narrative problem into a registration problem: 'too many soldiers died' becomes 'what did each dead man die of, and on which bed' — nothing is discussable until it is registered
Fix the register's fields in advance: cause (wounds/zymotic/other), time (by month), place (ward/camp) — fields first, collection second, to prevent post-hoc cherry-picking
Build the collection routine: nurses' shift records flowing into hospital paperwork, entered daily — a register lives by continuity, not completeness

Answer attack with the register: when accused of exaggerating deaths, do not argue sentiment — recompute from the War Office's own figures; the 1859 anonymous Contribution proved the critics wrong and herself an under-estimator
representative_cases_zh: 斯库塔里军医院的死亡登记制度：1854-55 年她在军医院首先建立的病案与死亡逐案登记——此后一切统计论证的地基
《英国陆军卫生史略》(1859)：面对'她夸大了死亡'的小册子攻击，用官方公布的数字匿名应战，证明自己反而低估
克里米亚死亡数据与法尔的两年重算：把战时混乱的记录整理为法尔式登记格式，'惨状'第一次变成可比时间序列
representative_cases_en: Scutari's patient and mortality registration (1854-55) — the foundation of every later statistical argument
A Contribution to the Sanitary History of the British Army (1859): answering a pamphlet accusing her of exaggeration with the Army's own published figures, proving she had under-estimated
The two-year recomputation of Crimean data with William Farr: wartime chaos recast in G.R.O. registration format — 'appalling scenes' became a comparable time series
modern_applications_zh: 企业/系统的故障与事故底册：先把零散投诉与工单汇成字段固定的登记册，再谈根因与优先级
公共卫生监测：传染病逐案上报与基因分型底账（新冠、霍乱、耐药菌追踪的同构操作）
临床科研的数据注册库（registry）：先立字段再收病人，防止事后挑数据
modern_applications_en: Enterprise incident/complaint registries: consolidate scattered tickets into fixed-field ledgers before root-cause work
Public-health surveillance: case-based notifiable-disease and genomic ledgers (the same operation behind COVID, cholera and AMR tracking)
Clinical research registries: fields before patients, so no post-hoc cherry-picking
related_modes: M-NIG-002（干预对照归因法——底册法的下一步：登记完成后如何做因果归因）
M-NIG-003（图形转译法——底册读数如何变成权力能懂的图形）

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype — opened the sanitary reform with Scutari's death registration

representative_figures.relation_zh: 登记方法的同调者——总登记处的登记-统计体系为她的底册提供了格式与协作
representative_figures.relation_en: the fellow traveller — the G.R.O.'s registration-statistics system gave her ledger its format and collaboration

modes.domain_zh: 科学方法论/准实验因果归因
modes.definition_zh: 因果归因方法论/以干预前后的同期对照代替模糊相关：当某项干预（卫生委员会的大扫除）介入系统后死亡率骤变，把干预时点作为切片轴，比较前后同构时段的月度死亡率——归因不靠辩才而靠对照；同时诚实排除竞争解释（战事强度变化等），承认自己护理非主因
modes.definition_en: Causal methodology: replace vague correlation with before-versus-after comparison around the intervention — use the intervention's date (the Sanitary Commission's flushing) as a slicing axis and compare structurally identical monthly periods on either side; attribution comes from comparison, not eloquence — and competing explanations (changes in combat intensity) are honestly weighed, even to the point of admitting her own nursing was not the main cause
modes.source_chapter: 《英国陆军卫生史略》(1859)、极区图双联设计（1858-59）
key_concepts: 干预时点切片 intervention-point slicing（以干预日期切分时间轴）
同构时段对照 structurally identical comparison（同样 12 个月、同样口径）
竞争解释排除 rival-explanation screening（战伤/季节/兵力变化逐一过秤）
modes.key_quote_zh: 卫生委员会到来之后，死亡率从 52% 降至 20%——这一变化发生的时点，就是归因的证据；我必须诚实地说：功劳首先属于清出的下水道，而不是提灯。
modes.key_quote_en: After the Sanitary Commission arrived, mortality fell from 52% to 20% — the date of that fall is itself the evidence; and honesty compels me to say: the credit belongs first to the flushed sewers, not to the lamp.
process_zh: 识别天然实验：系统里已发生的干预（政府卫生委员会 1855 年 3 月进场）本身就是实验处理，不需要自己制造实验条件
切片对齐：以干预月份为轴，把前后各 12 个月按相同口径（每千人月死亡率）并排——克里米亚数据的双联玫瑰图左右两圆正是这一切片的视觉化
过秤竞争解释：战事强度、兵力构成、季节变化逐一与死亡率曲线对照——凡不能被排除的解释都要在论证中如实列出
接受不利的自我归因：数据证明主要功臣是卫生工程而非护理，就把这一结论写进论证——归因的公信力来自对己不利的诚实
process_en: Spot the natural experiment: an intervention already injected into the system (the Commission's March 1855 arrival) is the treatment — no need to manufacture conditions

Align the slicing: with the intervention month as axis, set the twelve months before and after side by side on identical terms (deaths per 1,000 per month) — the twin rose diagrams are exactly this slice made visible
Weigh rival explanations: combat intensity, force composition, season — each checked against the mortality curve, and any that cannot be excluded stated openly
Accept the unfavourable attribution: the data showed sanitary engineering, not nursing, did the work — so that conclusion goes into the argument; credibility comes from honesty against oneself
representative_cases_zh: 卫生委员会干预前后的死亡率对照：1855 年 3 月大扫除前后月度死亡率的断崖——'干预时点即证据'的教科书一例
双联玫瑰图的设计：把干预前后各 12 个月画成左右两圆，使归因结论在视觉上不证自明
对己不利的归因修正：南丁格尔公开承认功劳属于卫生工程与管道工，而非护士团队——以诚实的自我归因换取论证公信力
representative_cases_en: The mortality fall around the Commission's flushing of March 1855 — the textbook case of 'the intervention point is the evidence'
The twin rose diagrams: twelve months before and after rendered as two circles, making the attribution visible without argument
The self-detrimental correction: Nightingale conceded publicly that the credit lay with sanitary engineering and plumbers, not nurses — buying credibility through honest attribution
modern_applications_zh: A/B 测试与灰度发布的因果解读：以发布时点为切片轴，对照同构时段的核心指标，而非只看发布后趋势
政策评估（打断时间序列 ITS）：最小干预工资、禁烟令、限行政策的'干预前后'月度序列对照
事故复盘归因：变更窗口前后系统指标对照，先排除同时段其他变更再定责
modern_applications_en: A/B tests and staged rollouts: slice at the release point, compare structurally identical periods, not just the post-launch trend
Policy evaluation (interrupted time series): minimum-wage, smoking-ban and traffic-restriction policies read as before/after monthly series
Incident retrospectives: compare system metrics across the change window, excluding concurrent changes before assigning cause

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/统计证据的可视化说服
modes.domain_en: Methodology / visual persuasion of statistical evidence
modes.definition_zh: 决策沟通方法论/把统计表格翻译成权力一眼可懂的图形：决策者不读回归表，但看得懂两个圆并排的大小——极区面积图以 12 个等角楔面对应 12 个月，蓝色楔面（可预防疾病）压倒红色楔面（战伤），使'环境而非战争在杀人'的结论无需任何数字就能被看见；图形不是装饰而是论证的完成形态
modes.definition_en: Decision-communication methodology: translate statistical tables into graphics a minister grasps at a glance — the polar-area diagram's twelve equal-angle wedges map the twelve months, blue preventable-disease wedges dwarfing red wound wedges, so that 'the environment, not the war, is doing the killing' is seen before it is read; the graphic is not decoration but the finished form of the argument
modes.source_chapter: 1858《Notes on Matters...》极区图、1859《英国陆军卫生史略》'wedges' 定稿版
key_concepts: 极区面积图 polar-area diagram（等角楔面、半径按平方根标度）
单图单论点 one graphic, one claim（蓝色压倒红色 = 环境在杀人）
面向权力的图形设计 design-for-the-decision-maker（挂进陆军司令部办公室的尺寸与构图）
modes.key_quote_zh: 要通过眼睛去打动那些用耳朵听不进public话语的人——报告可以收到柜子里，图会挂在墙上。
modes.key_quote_en: To affect through the eyes what we may fail to convey to the brains of the public through their word-proof ears — a report can be shelved; a diagram gets hung on the wall.
process_zh: 提炼单论点：从全部表格中先定'这一张图要证明的唯一命题'（可预防疾病死亡压倒战伤）——没有单一论点就没有图形设计
选图形语法：按数据的比较结构选形（月份周期→等角楔面；死亡率→楔面大小），而非按美观选形
设计对照冲击：把需要对比的两态（卫生委员会前后）做成左右双圆——一眼即见右侧远小于左侧
把图形送进决策现场：印成册页分送王室与政府要员（Mortality of the Army 小册 2000 份），并设计成可挂于司令部办公室的版式——图要出现在决策发生的房间里
process_en: Extract the single claim: before designing any graphic, fix the one proposition it must prove (preventable disease dwarfs wounds) — no single claim, no design
Choose the graphic grammar by comparison structure, not beauty: monthly cycle → equal-angle wedges; death rate → wedge size
Engineer the contrast: the two states to be compared (before/after the Commission) become twin circles — the smaller right circle lands at first glance

Deliver the graphic into the decision room: printed booklets to the Royal Family and ministers (2,000 copies of Mortality of the Army) and formats designed to hang in Army offices — the graphic must be where decisions happen
representative_cases_zh: 极区面积图的一图定案：蓝色楔面（可预防疾病）压倒红色楔面（战伤）——'环境在杀人'无需数字即被看见
《Mortality of the Army》小册的 2000 份分发：图形进入王室与内阁的案头，而不止停留于报告附录
面向司令部办公室的挂图版式：把统计图设计成决策现场的常驻陈设
representative_cases_en: The one-chart verdict of the polar-area diagram: blue preventable-disease wedges dwarf red wound wedges — 'the environment is killing' seen without numbers
The 2,000-copy distribution of Mortality of the Army: the graphic reaching royal and ministerial desks, not merely a report appendix
The hangable format for Army command offices: the statistical diagram designed as permanent furnishing of the decision room
modern_applications_zh: 管理汇报的'一图定案'：把季度复盘的核心结论压成一张对比图（并非仪表盘堆砌），先定论点再选图
政策倡导的数据可视化：把复杂统计转译为公众与立法者一眼可懂的对比图（复现玫瑰图的社会功能）
产品/运营的核心指标看板：以'单图单论点+前后对照'为设计纪律，反对无主张的指标堆砌
modern_applications_en: Executive one-chart verdicts: compress the quarterly review's core claim into one contrast chart (not dashboard sprawl) — claim first, chart second
Advocacy data-visualisation: translating complex statistics into one-glance contrasts for the public and legislators (the rose diagram's social function, reproduced)
Product/ops KPI boards: design discipline of one-chart-one-claim with before/after contrast, against claimless metric pile-ups

M-NIG-002（干预对照归因法——双圆对照正是归因结论的图形化）
M-NIG-004（自误自纠法——初版图形被自己推翻重制）

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype — inventor and self-reviser of the polar-area diagram

representative_figures.relation_en: the forerunner of the graphic grammar — his 1852 radial cholera diagram lent her the form she then improved

representative_figures.relation_zh: 统计图形传统的奠基者——条形图与饼图的先行者，为'图形即论证'开了先河
representative_figures.relation_en: the founder of the statistical-graphic tradition — bar and pie charts preceded her, opening 'graphic as argument'

modes.domain_zh: 元方法/对自己产物的主动废弃与重构
modes.domain_en: Meta-methodology / active abandonment and reconstruction of one's own products
modes.definition_zh: 认知品质方法论/发现自己产物的方法论缺陷后主动废弃重制，而非辩护修补：初版极区图以半径长度编码死亡率，她随即察觉视觉系统读的是面积而非长度——半径加倍给人四倍的错觉；于是废弃自己的初版图式，改用平方根标度使楔面面积正比于死亡率，并附勘误条、在新版文献中全面替换旧图——对自己错误的处理速度与对他人错误的挑剔同格
modes.definition_en: Cognitive-quality methodology: upon discovering a methodological flaw in one's own product, abandon and rebuild it instead of defending and patching — her first polar diagram encoded death rates as radial length, but she saw at once that the eye reads area, not length (doubling the radius reads as four-fold area); she discarded her own first design, re-scaled to square roots so wedge areas matched death rates, inserted an erratum slip and replaced the old diagram across all later documents — the speed of self-correction equal to the rigour demanded of others
modes.source_chapter: 1858 初版'bat's wing'图 → 1858 末勘误条 → 1859 'wedges' 定稿版；York 统计史料对三版演变的考证
key_concepts: 错误察觉 error detection（以'读者实际读到什么'为标准而非'我画了什么'）
主动废弃 active abandonment（附勘误条、撤回初版）
系统性替换 systematic replacement（新版文献全面用新图，不留两个版本并行）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我必须承认初版图会欺骗眼睛——半径加倍，读数却是四倍；错的图比没有图更危险，因为它挂着'精确'的招牌。
modes.key_quote_en: I must admit my first diagram deceives the eye — double the radius reads as four-fold; a wrong chart is more dangerous than none, for it wears the badge of precision.
process_zh: 以读者视角复检自己的产物：定期问'使用者实际会读出什么'（眼睛读面积而非半径），而不是'我编码了什么'
发现缺陷后定裁决标准：缺陷若影响结论传达（视觉比例失真），必须重制而非在图注里补救
公开勘误而非沉默替换：附勘误条说明旧图误在哪、新图如何改——修正过程本身也作为证据的一部分公开
全版本统一：后续所有文献（1859-60 各版）统一使用修正后图式，防止旧版继续流传误导
process_en: Re-inspect your own product from the reader's seat: regularly ask what users actually read (the eye reads area, not radius), not what you encoded
Fix the adjudication standard before rebuilding: if the flaw distorts the conclusion's delivery (visual proportion), the artefact must be rebuilt, not patched in a caption
Erratum in the open, not silent replacement: a slip stating what the old diagram got wrong and how the new one differs — the correction process itself published as part of the evidence
Unify all versions: every later document (1859-60 editions) carries only the corrected diagram, so no obsolete version circulates to mislead
representative_cases_zh: 初版'bat's wing'图的废弃：以半径长度编码死亡率造成视觉夸大，随即发现眼睛读的是面积
勘误条与 'wedges' 定稿版：1858 年末主动附勘误、以平方根标度重制，此后各版文献统一使用修正图
三版演变的完整链条：1858 初版 → 勘误 → 1859 定稿——自我修正的全过程本身成为统计诚信的示范
representative_cases_en: The abandonment of the first 'bat's wing' diagram: radial-length encoding exaggerated visually; she saw at once that the eye reads area
The erratum slip and the definitive 'wedges': re-scaled by square roots in late 1858, with all later editions carrying only the corrected diagram
The full three-version chain: 1858 original → erratum → 1859 definitive — the whole self-correction itself became a demonstration of statistical integrity
modern_applications_zh: 数据可视化团队的自查制度：定期用'读者三秒测试'复检自家图表的误导风险，发现即全库替换而非打补丁
工程系统的废弃式重构：确认初版架构缺陷后主动废弃重写（如 API v1 → v2 的显式 deprecation 与勘误文档）
知识产品的勘误文化：论文/文档错误公开勘误、版本统一，反对'悄悄改了不提'
modern_applications_en: Visualisation self-audit: periodic 'three-second reader test' of one's own charts for misleading risk; on discovery, replace across the library, not patch
Abandon-and-rebuild in engineering: once a v1 architecture flaw is confirmed, explicit deprecation with erratum-style migration docs
An erratum culture for knowledge products: public corrections and version unification, against silent edits
related_modes: M-NIG-003（图形转译法——被自纠的对象正是转译图形）
M-NIG-002（干预对照归因法——对己不利的归因结论是同一种诚实）
M-SK-001（沈括·广泛观察累积法——同为以'读者/现象实际如何'校验自身判断的经验主义品格）

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype — scrapped and rebuilt her own first rose diagram with her own hand

representative_figures.relation_en: the historian of this self-correction — his scholarship reconstructed the misleading first design and the erratum

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同时代图形大师——其 1869 年拿破仑东征图与她的玫瑰图同属'图形即论证'的巅峰，互为镜像
representative_figures.relation_en: the contemporary master of graphics — his 1869 Russia campaign map and her rose diagram are twin peaks of 'graphic as argument'

modes.domain_zh: 护理学与环境医学/以环境为主变量的健康干预
modes.domain_en: Nursing and environmental medicine / environment as the primary health intervention
modes.definition_zh: 健康干预方法论/把环境条件（通风、光、暖、洁、静、食）当作疾病转归的第一变量而非背景：'护理'的定义不是伺候病人，而是把人体置于最利于自我修复的状态——病房的窗户、下水道与被褥比药柜更接近治疗的中心；这一环境论先于细菌学与流行病学半个世纪，却在干预对照数据上得到支撑
modes.definition_en: Health-intervention methodology: treat environmental conditions — ventilation, light, warmth, cleanliness, quiet, food — as the first variable of disease outcome, not the backdrop: 'nursing' is not attending to the sick but putting the body in the state most favourable to its repair; the ward's windows, sewers and bedding stand nearer the centre of therapy than the medicine cabinet — an environmental doctrine half a century ahead of bacteriology and epidemiology, yet supported by before/after data
key_concepts: 环境五要素 the five essentials（通风、光、暖、洁、静）
复愈条件 repair conditions（护理=安置最佳复愈环境）
环境致病链 environmental pathogenesis（瘴气时代的正确直觉：环境致病的方向对了，机制的名字错了）
modes.key_quote_zh: 护理的本义：把人体置于最佳状态，让自然（nature）对病人施行治愈——开窗这件事，比许多药更接近治疗。
modes.key_quote_en: Nursing proper: putting the body in the best state for nature to act upon the patient — opening the window is nearer to cure than many medicines.
process_zh: 列出环境变量清单：通风、光、暖、洁、静、食逐项可观察、可测量、可执行——环境不是氛围而是参数
把环境变量接入登记底册：病房条件与死亡率同册记录，使'环境-转归'关系可被数据检验
以低成本高杠杆排序干预：开窗、洗涤、通下水道先于昂贵设备——对克里米亚 mortality 曲线影响最大的是卫生工程而非新药
把环境论写成可传播的守则：《护理笔记》以'每个妇女都是护士'的口吻把环境知识送进家庭——方法论若只在医院成立就不算成立
process_en: List environmental variables as observable, measurable, executable parameters: ventilation, light, warmth, cleanliness, quiet, food — environment is not atmosphere but parameter
Wire the variables into the register: ward conditions recorded alongside mortality, so the environment-outcome relation is testable
Rank interventions by low cost, high leverage: windows, laundry, sewers before expensive equipment — what moved the Crimean curve was sanitary engineering, not new drugs

Write the doctrine into transmissible rules: Notes on Nursing carries environmental knowledge into every household ('every woman is a nurse') — a method that works only inside the hospital is not yet a method
representative_cases_zh: 斯库塔里病房的通风-洗涤-供水改革：开窗、洗衣与下水道清理先于新药——死亡率曲线随之断崖
《护理笔记》的环境守则进家庭：'每个妇女都是护士'——环境知识从军医院走进英国的中产家庭
亭式病房设计（1863《医院笔记》）：把环境论固化进建筑本身——空间即处方
representative_cases_en: The ventilation-laundry-water reform at Scutari: windows, washing and sewers before new drugs — the mortality cliff followed
Notes on Nursing carrying environmental rules into households: 'every woman is a nurse' — environmental knowledge moving from military hospital to the English home
The pavilion-ward design (Notes on Hospitals, 1863): the doctrine fixed into architecture itself — space as prescription
modern_applications_zh: 职业健康与工效学：把光照、噪音、通风、工位作为生产率与病假率的一级变量来管理，而非福利点缀
建筑与医院设计的循证化：亭式病房、自然采光与通风标准（现代医院设计规范的远祖）
慢病管理的环境干预：睡眠、饮食环境与运动可及性作为处方级变量（如'运动是良医'处方案）
modern_applications_en: Occupational health and ergonomics: light, noise, ventilation and workstation as first-class variables of productivity and absenteeism, not welfare garnish
Evidence-based hospital architecture: pavilion wards, daylighting and ventilation standards (remote ancestors of modern hospital design codes)
Environmental prescription in chronic-disease management: sleep, food environment and exercise access as prescribable variables ('Exercise is Medicine')
related_modes: M-NIG-001（登记底册法——环境变量入册才可检验）
M-NIG-002（干预对照归因法——环境干预正是被归因的'干预'）
M-NIG-008（先数据后道德法——环境论的数据支撑先于道德呼吁）
M-MON-010（孟德斯鸠·制度移植适配检验法——同为'条件决定结果'的条件敏感思维）

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype — established the environment-repair doctrine in Notes on Nursing

representative_figures.relation_zh: 英国卫生运动的总工程师——其公共卫生总局的官署统计与她的环境论同源共振
representative_figures.relation_en: chief engineer of the English sanitary movement — the Medical Department's official statistics resonated with her environmental doctrine

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同构先声——以洗手这一环境/操作变量压低产褥热死亡率，同在细菌学之前以数据立论
representative_figures.relation_en: the structural precursor — cut puerperal fever via handwashing, likewise arguing from data before bacteriology

modes.domain_zh: 制度设计/统计口径的跨组织标准化
modes.domain_en: Institutional design / cross-organisational standardisation of statistical formats
modes.definition_zh: 制度标准化方法论/让不同组织的数字可以互相比较，改革才能跨组织扩散：各家医院各记各的死亡率，'哪家更好'永远吵不清——1860 年她向国际统计大会提交医院统计统一方案，把年龄、性别、病类、术后并发症定为必填分层项；先立口径再谈比较，先可比较再谈问责
modes.definition_en: Institutional-standardisation methodology: reform can only spread across organisations when their numbers are mutually comparable — every hospital counting deaths its own way leaves 'which is better' permanently unanswerable; her 1860 scheme to the International Statistical Congress fixed age, sex, disease class and post-operative complications as mandatory strata; agreement on the measure precedes comparison, and comparability precedes accountability
modes.source_chapter: 1860 年国际统计大会医院统计统一方案、《医院笔记》(1863) 论粗死亡率之不可比
key_concepts: 统一口径 uniform nomenclature（必填分层项：年龄/性别/病类/并发症）
粗死亡率批判 the crude-rate critique（不问分母构成的死亡率'只能给出非常不完美的图景'）
跨院可比性 cross-hospital comparability（问责与学习的前提）
modes.key_quote_zh: 不问年龄、性别、手术类型与术后并发症的死亡率估计，至多给出非常松散的近似——它既不能传达病情的真相，也必然通向不了任何实际结果。
modes.key_quote_en: Estimates of mortality made without reference to age, sex, type of operation or post-operative complications can at best lead to very loose approximations: they convey an imperfect idea of the real state of the case, and can lead to no practical result whatever.
process_zh: 诊断现状：列出组织间数字不可比的具体症结（各记各的、分母构成不同、病类口径漂移）
定最小必填集：与领域专家商定不可省略的分层项（年龄/性别/病类/并发症）——必填集宁少而硬，不多而软
推动国际/行业共识：把方案送上统计大会或行业标准平台，使口径成为公共品而非一家的内部规定
以粗口径的失败案例立论：举证'不问分母的死亡率如何误导决策'（粗死亡率把康复医院与临终医院排在同一榜上），使标准化成为必需而非洁癖
process_en: Diagnose the present: name the exact reasons numbers are incomparable across units (everyone counts their own way, different denominators, drifting disease categories)
Fix the minimal mandatory set: settle with domain experts the strata that cannot be omitted (age/sex/disease class/complications) — few and hard, not many and soft
Drive the consensus: take the scheme to a congress or industry body so the measure becomes a public good, not one firm's private rule

Argue from the failure of crude measures: show how denominators-blind death rates mislead decisions (a recovery hospital ranked against a hospice), making standardisation a necessity, not fastidiousness
representative_cases_zh: 1860 年国际统计大会方案：年龄/性别/病类/并发症四层必填项的提出——医院统计第一次拥有公共口径
《医院笔记》对粗死亡率的系统批判：康复医院与临终医院同榜排名的荒谬作为立论武器
风险调整死亡率的现代回响：今天医院的'风险调整后死亡率'正是她'粗口径不可比'论证的直接制度化
representative_cases_en: The 1860 Congress scheme: age/sex/disease-class/complications as four mandatory strata — hospital statistics gains its first public nomenclature
The systematic critique of crude rates in Notes on Hospitals: the absurdity of ranking a recovery hospital against a hospice as the argument's weapon
The modern echo in risk-adjusted mortality: today's risk-adjusted hospital death rates are her crude-rate critique institutionalised
modern_applications_zh: 医院与医保的质量指标标准化（DRG/DIP 分组、风险调整死亡率——风险调整正是她'粗死亡率批判'的直接后裔）
企业跨部门指标口径治理：先统一'活跃用户/事故率/按时率'的定义再排 leaderboard，防止口径游戏
国际组织统计标准（WHO 死因编码 ICD 的持续推进同构）

Cross-department metric governance in firms: define 'active user / incident rate / on-time rate' before publishing leaderboards, against definition gaming
International statistical standards (the ongoing ICD cause-of-death coding, structurally identical)

modes.domain_zh: 实践论/病榻上的系统性远程领导
modes.domain_en: Practice / systematic remote leadership from a sickbed
modes.definition_zh: 领导方式方法论/把'不在场'从领导的缺陷改造为领导的杠杆：克里米亚归来后她因慢性病常年卧床，却以每日数百封书信、小册与私下印刷品指挥全球卫生改革——把意见写成可被转发、可被引用、可被委员会采信的'文件'，使影响力不依赖肉身在场；远程指挥的纪律是：每一封信念里有具体的数字、具体的名字、具体的下一步
modes.definition_en: Leadership methodology: turn 'not being present' from a leader's weakness into a lever — bedridden for decades after Crimea, she directed global sanitary reform through hundreds of letters, pamphlets and privately printed papers a day; opinions were written to be forwarded, quoted and admitted into committees, so influence stopped depending on bodily presence; the discipline of remote command: every letter carries a concrete number, a concrete name, a concrete next step
modes.source_chapter: 1860-1907 年书信档案、致印度总督与陆军部的改革建议书
key_concepts: 文件化影响力 documentary influence（意见写成可转发的文件而非口头忠告）
具体性纪律 the concreteness discipline（数字/名字/下一步，缺一不发）
以病榻为中心的星形网络 the hub-and-spoke network（她居中，全球 correspondents 为辐条）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我可以不出这间屋子——只要每一封信都带着一个数字、一个名字和一件下周就该发生的事，整个帝国的卫生行政就会替我走完剩下的路。
modes.key_quote_en: I need never leave this room — if every letter carries a number, a name, and one thing to be done next week, the sanitary administration of the Empire will walk the rest of the road for me.
process_zh: 把口头影响力改造成文件资产：凡要紧的意见必落成小册、备忘或信件，使其可被转发、引用与归档
设计'可执行的信'：每封信锁定一个收件人能在一周内启动的具体动作——无具体下一步的信不发
经营星形网络：与总督、大臣、统计学家、殖民地医官保持一对多的定期通信，使自己成为信息与议程的枢纽
以持续在场代替偶尔出场：数十年如一日的书信流使'她不在场'不再构成改革的瓶颈——远程领导的复利在频率不在强度
process_en: Convert spoken influence into documentary assets: every consequential opinion becomes a pamphlet, memo or letter — forwardable, quotable, archivable
Design the executable letter: each one locks in one action the recipient can start within a week — no concrete next step, no send
Cultivate the hub-and-spoke network: regular one-to-many correspondence with governors, ministers, statisticians and colonial medical officers, making yourself the hub of information and agenda
Replace occasional appearances with continuous presence: decades of steady letters remove 'she is not here' as a bottleneck of reform — remote leadership compounds by frequency, not intensity
representative_cases_zh: 分布式团队的异步领导：以书面决策记录（ADR/周报）代替口头拍板，使决策可被异地执行与审计
高层顾问与董事会治理：以精确的备忘与'下一周动作'清单影响组织，而不需要每日在场
开源社区核心维护者的 BDFL 模式：以邮件列表与 RFC 文件流远程治理全球贡献者
representative_cases_en: Asynchronous leadership in distributed teams: written decision records (ADRs/weekly notes) instead of verbal sign-offs, so decisions can be executed and audited remotely
Advisory and board governance: precise memos and next-week action lists that steer an organisation without daily presence
The BDFL pattern in open source: governing a global contributor base through mailing lists and RFC document flow
modern_applications_zh: Decades of sickbed correspondence: hundreds of letters a day advancing the Indian sanitary survey, hospital design and nurse registration simultaneously
The discipline of the executable letter: every letter to the Viceroy or War Office secretary locks in one concrete action and its next owner
The compound interest of documentary assets: pamphlets quoted by committees and reprinted by opponents — her absent influence ran deeper than presence
modern_applications_en: 病榻书信流的数十年运转：每日数百封信件使印度卫生调查、医院设计与护理注册同时推进
'可执行的信'的纪律：致印度总督与陆军部秘书的信每封锁定一个具体动作与下一步责任人
文件资产的复利：小册与备忘被委员会引用、被对手转载——她不在场的影响反而比在场更深

modes.domain_zh: 元方法/以证据为道德诉求的前置条件
modes.domain_en: Meta-methodology / evidence as the precondition of moral appeal
modes.definition_zh: 改革修辞的方法论次序/道德义愤必须由数据供养，否则会在辩论中破产：她从不先喊'士兵惨死'再找数据，而是先让死亡登记、对照与图形把'可预防'钉死，再让道德结论作为数据的不由自主的推论出场——'这些士兵死于我们可以阻止的原因'比'士兵死得太多'多出整个可行性；次序颠倒的道德呼吁只会换来同情，换不来预算
modes.definition_en: The methodological order of reform rhetoric: moral indignation must be fed by data or it goes bankrupt in debate — she never cried 'soldiers are dying horribly' and then looked for numbers; she let registration, comparison and graphics nail down 'preventable' first, so the moral conclusion emerged as the involuntary corollary of the data: 'these men died of causes we can prevent' contains the entire feasibility that 'too many soldiers died' lacks; a moral appeal in the wrong order buys sympathy, not budgets
modes.source_chapter: 《护理笔记》对'善心不等于知识'的反复论证、《英国陆军卫生史略》的应战结构
key_concepts: 义愤的数据供养 indignation fed by data（道德结论作为统计推论出场）
'可预防'的可信断言 the credible 'preventable'（证据先于'应当'）
同情与预算的区分 sympathy vs budget（辩论的终点是拨款而非感动）
modes.key_quote_zh: 慈善家有满腔的恻隐却两手空空——而我们手里的每个数字都在说：这些死亡本可以被阻止；把'本可以阻止'证明出来，剩下的善心自会找到它的预算。
modes.key_quote_en: Philanthropists are full of pity and empty of means — while every figure in our hands says these deaths could have been prevented; prove the 'could have been prevented', and goodwill will find its budget on its own.
process_zh: 把道德命题改写为经验命题：'这是不义'先翻译为'这些死亡由可变更的条件导致'——先可检验后可谴责
用底册-对照-图形三步把'可预防'钉死：登记给出死因结构，对照给出干预弹性，图形给出决策者的看见
让道德结论作为推论出场：'因此我们有责任阻止'写在证据之后，使反对者必须先反驳数据才能反驳道德
用'可预防性'框定预算论证：向财政部陈述的不是'请行善'而是'这是一笔回报率最高的支出'——道德经数字获得财政语言
process_en: 克里米亚改革的论证次序：先以登记与对照钉死'可预防疾病是主因'，'我们有责任阻止'作为数据推论出场
对财政部的陈述结构：不诉诸善心，而陈述'这是回报率最高的支出'——道德经数字获得财政语言
《护理笔记》的立论姿态：'善心不等于知识'——先教读者看见条件与转归的因果，再谈护理之责
representative_cases_zh: The argument order of the Crimean reform: registration and comparison nailed 'preventable disease is the main cause' first; 'we are bound to prevent it' entered as the data's corollary
The structure of the Treasury case: no appeal to charity, but the statement 'this is the highest-returning expenditure available' — morality acquiring fiscal language through numbers
The argumentative posture of Notes on Nursing: 'goodwill is not knowledge' — the reader first sees the cause-effect of conditions and outcomes, then the duty of nursing
representative_cases_en: Rewrite the moral proposition as an empirical one: 'this is injustice' becomes 'these deaths are caused by alterable conditions' — testable before condemnable

Nail down 'preventable' in three steps — register, compare, visualise: the register gives the structure of causes, the comparison gives the leverage of intervention, the graphic gives decision-makers the seeing
Let the moral conclusion enter as a corollary: 'therefore we are bound to prevent it' written after the evidence, forcing opponents to refute the data before refuting the morality
Frame the budget case on preventability: to the Treasury one does not say 'be charitable' but 'this is the highest-returning expenditure available' — morality acquires fiscal language through numbers
modern_applications_zh: 公共政策的倡导次序：先算可避免负担（avoidable burden）再谈伦理责任——控烟、 road safety、疫苗接种的论证皆循此序
企业 ESG 的可信化：用可审计数据把'责任'变成'可验证的改善率'，防止道德口号空心化
质量与安全文化的推动：用事故率与可预防比例说服管理层投入，而非单纯诉诸'人命关天'
modern_applications_en: The order of public-policy advocacy: quantified avoidable burden before ethical duty — tobacco control, road safety and vaccination arguments all follow this sequence
Making corporate ESG credible: auditable data turning 'responsibility' into 'verifiable improvement rates', against hollow moral slogans
Driving safety culture: incident rates and preventable fractions persuading management to invest, beyond the bare appeal to 'lives at stake'

modes.domain_zh: 制度设计/跨越等级与性别的非正式联盟
modes.domain_en: Institutional design / informal coalitions across rank and gender
modes.definition_zh: 无权者的改革策略/当制度拒绝给你席位时，用信息与能力在等级与性别的外墙之间织一张非正式联盟网：她不能进入议会与陆军部，但能让统计学家（法尔）供给口径、政治家（赫伯特）供给通道、王室供给背书、记者供给舆论——每个盟友拿走她数据的不同切片；联盟的粘合剂不是忠诚而是互利的证据交换
modes.definition_en: Reform strategy for the unseated: when institutions deny you a seat, weave an informal coalition across the walls of rank and gender using information and competence — barred from Parliament and the War Office, she had statisticians (Farr) supply the nomenclature, politicians (Herbert) supply the channels, the Crown supply endorsement and the press supply opinion, each ally taking a different slice of her data; the coalition's glue is not loyalty but mutually profitable exchange of evidence
modes.source_chapter: 与法尔二十年合作、与赫伯特的战争通信、1856-57 年面见维多利亚女王与潘缪尔促成皇家委员会
key_concepts: 跨层信息交换 cross-level exchange of evidence（每个盟友取走数据的某个切片）
非正式权力网络 the informal power network（席位之外的影响力通道）
把反对者变成渠道 turning opponents into channels（陆军部从抵制者变成统计的供给方）
modes.key_quote_zh: 他们不给我席位——很好；那我就让每一个需要证据的人来我这里取证据：统计学家取口径，大臣取弹药，女王取理由。联盟不需要请柬，只需要各自都更强大。
modes.key_quote_en: They deny me a seat — very well; then let everyone who needs evidence come to me for it: the statisticians take the nomenclature, the ministers the ammunition, the Queen the reasons. A coalition needs no invitations, only that each party leave stronger.
process_zh: 绘制围墙地图：列出正式制度把你挡在门外的一切节点（议会、部委、学会）——目标不是砸墙而是找门
为每类盟友定制数据切片：统计学家要口径、大臣要弹药、王室要理由、报界要故事——同一底册的不同切片使人人有动机
建立交换的循环：盟友的每一次采用都反哺你的权威（女王采用→陆军部无法忽视→统计学会破格接纳首位女性成员）
保持联盟的独立性：不从属于任何派系，使数据在党争中始终是硬通货——你的中立性本身是联盟的公共品
process_en: Map the walls: list every node of the formal system that bars you (parliament, ministries, learned societies) — the aim is not to break walls but to find doors
Tailor a data slice for each ally: nomenclature for statisticians, ammunition for ministers, reasons for the Crown, stories for the press — different slices of one ledger give everyone a motive
Build the exchange loop: each adoption by an ally feeds back into your authority (the Queen adopts → the War Office cannot ignore → the Statistical Society admits its first woman)
Keep the coalition independent: belong to no faction, so the data remains hard currency across party strife — your neutrality is itself the coalition's public good
representative_cases_zh: 跨部门数据/合规联盟：风控或数据团队以'供给各部门需要的证据切片'建立超出职级的影响力
开放标准与开源治理：以中立的基础设施供给各竞争厂商，使其共同依赖你的资产（联盟的公共品逻辑）
政策倡导的多元盟友矩阵：学者、媒体、官僚、企业各取所需——同一份研究的多切片分发
representative_cases_en: Cross-department data/compliance coalitions: risk or data teams building influence beyond rank by supplying each department's needed slice of evidence
Open standards and OSS governance: a neutral infrastructure feeding competing vendors, all made dependent on your asset (the public-good logic of coalitions)
Multi-ally matrices in policy advocacy: scholars, media, officials and firms each taking what they need — one study, many slices
modern_applications_zh: 与法尔的二十年合作：总登记处供给口径与方法，她供给战役数据与传播火力——证据交换的长期同盟
1856-57 年的王室通道：面见维多利亚女王与潘缪尔勋爵，使皇家委员会得以设立
首位女性皇家统计学会成员 (1858)：数据能力迫使最排外的学会为其打开大门——联盟反哺权威的例证
modern_applications_en: The twenty-year collaboration with Farr: the G.R.O. supplied nomenclature and method while she supplied campaign data and communication firepower — a long alliance of exchanged evidence
The royal channel of 1856-57: audience with Queen Victoria and Lord Panmure that made the Royal Commission possible
First woman Fellow of the Statistical Society (1858): data competence forced the most exclusive of societies to open its doors — authority fed back by the coalition

modes.domain_zh: 制度设计/把一场战役的教训固化为常设制度
modes.domain_en: Institutional design / fixing one campaign's lessons into standing institutions
modes.definition_zh: 改革收束方法论/战役终会结束，只活在叙述里的教训会随叙述者一同死去——必须在其记忆尚热时把教训铸进常设制度：一场克里米亚战役收束为皇家委员会（1857）、陆军医学院、标准化统计格式、护士学校（1860）与护士注册制度；制度是教训的防遗忘编码，个人的退场不是改革的终点而是改革生效的证明
modes.definition_en: Reform-consolidation methodology: campaigns end, and lessons that live only in narrative die with the narrator — they must be cast into standing institutions while memory is still warm: one Crimean campaign consolidated into the Royal Commission (1857), the Army Medical College, standardised statistical formats, the Nightingale Training School (1860) and nurse registration; institutions are the anti-forgetting encoding of a lesson — the reformer's exit is not the end of reform but the proof that it has taken effect
modes.source_chapter: 1857 皇家委员会、1860 圣托马斯护士学校与《护理笔记》守则化、陆军统计改革
key_concepts: 教训的制度编码 institutional encoding of lessons（委员会/学校/标准格式）
防遗忘设计 anti-forgetting design（制度在叙述者退场后继续运转）
收束的时机 timing of consolidation（记忆尚热时立法）
modes.key_quote_zh: 请为我记住：不要给我立像——给卫生委员会立一块常设的预算科目；纪念会散场之后还能每天杀死旧错误的东西，才配称作纪念碑。
modes.key_quote_en: Remember this of me: build me no statue — build a standing budget line for the sanitary commission; only what keeps killing the old errors every day after the commemoration disperses deserves the name of monument.
process_zh: 在战役高峰期就起草制度方案：不等胜利——皇家委员会的推动始于死亡曲线尚未落定的 1856-57 年
把每一项经验翻译成一个机构：教训'环境致病'→卫生委员会；教训'护理是专业'→护士学校；教训'口径混乱'→统计标准
设置自我运转的闭环：委员会有法定职权、学校有招生与考核、标准有国际大会——每个机构离开创始人仍能招募、考核与修订
以个人退场检验收束质量：制度若仍依赖你本人，收束未完成——她隐入病榻而改革继续加速，即收束成功的终验
process_en: Draft the institutional plan at the campaign's peak, not after victory — the push for the Royal Commission began in 1856-57 while the mortality curve was still falling

Translate each lesson into one institution: 'environment causes disease' → the Sanitary Commission; 'nursing is a profession' → the training school; 'confusion of nomenclature' → statistical standards
